story.paragraph: We believe a restaurant is, above all, about teamwork. Our dining room, kitchen, and pizzeria work together every day with the same philosophy: to make every guest feel welcome, cared for, and completely at home.

owner.altOwner: Mattia Ambrosi, the heart behind Grano e Gusto
owner.paragraphBefore: At the heart of this journey is
owner.paragraphAfter1: , a young pizza chef who turned a passion discovered almost by chance into a profession built on dedication, continuous learning, and experience.
owner.paragraphAfter2: For Mattia, learning never stops: the more you grow and refine your skills, the better the food and the experience you can offer your guests.

events.paragraph1: Themed evenings, special events, and the latest news from Grano e Gusto.
events.paragraph2: Follow us on Instagram to stay up to date!

menuHero.paragraphBefore: Every dish and every pizza is crafted with the same
menuHero.paragraphAfter: for quality ingredients, traditional techniques, and the constant pursuit of the best possible result.

cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy describes the use of cookies and similar technologies on the Grano e Gusto Pizzeria Ristorante website.
cookiePolicy.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files that websites can store on a user's device while they browse.
cookiePolicy.technicalCookiesText: The website may use technical cookies that are necessary for the proper functioning of its pages and for managing user preferences. These cookies do not require prior consent.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyCookiesText: The website embeds Google Maps to display the restaurant's location. This service may install cookies or collect technical information related to the user's browsing activity.
cookiePolicy.externalServicesText: The website contains links to external services, including Lasersoft for online reservations, Google Maps, Instagram and WhatsApp. When users access these services, the processing of their personal data is governed by the respective Privacy Policies and Cookie Policies.
cookiePolicy.analyticsText: The website does not currently use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or other advertising profiling tools. If analytics or marketing tools are introduced in the future, this Cookie Policy will be updated and, where required by law, users will be asked to provide their consent.
cookiePolicy.preferencesText: Users can manage or delete cookies through their browser settings. If non-essential cookies are introduced, the website will request the user's consent before they are activated.
cookiePolicy.updatesText: This Cookie Policy may be updated over time. Last updated: June 2026.

privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how personal data of users visiting the Grano e Gusto Pizzeria Ristorante website is processed.
privacyPolicy.dataTypesText: The website may process technical browsing data such as IP address, browser information, device information and other data necessary for the proper functioning of the website.
privacyPolicy.purposesText: Personal data is processed to enable website navigation, provide information about the restaurant, allow users to contact us by phone, email, WhatsApp or Instagram, and redirect users to external services such as Google Maps and the Lasersoft online booking platform.
privacyPolicy.googleMapsText: The website embeds Google Maps to display the restaurant's location. Google may collect data related to the use of the map.
privacyPolicy.lasersoftText: Online reservations are managed through the external Lasersoft platform. By clicking the booking button, users are redirected to a third-party website subject to its own Privacy Policy.
privacyPolicy.legalBasisText: The processing is based on the legitimate interest of the Data Controller in ensuring the proper functioning of the website and providing information about the business. If non-essential cookies or similar technologies are introduced, they will only be used after obtaining the user's consent.
privacyPolicy.rightsText: Users may request access to, correction, deletion, restriction of, or object to the processing of their personal data by contacting us at
privacyPolicy.updatesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated over time. Last updated: June 2026.
